German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius:
I would first like to congratulate the Democrats on their truly remarkable electoral victory, securing a majority in the House of Representatives.
That outcome seemed fairly clear to many beforehand. But to also have such a clear situation in the Senate, this will shift the balance of power within the United States.
At the same time, our primary point of contact remains the Donald Trump administration. The government is elected to serve until the end of 2028.

BREAKING: Trump is considering replacing Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth following Republicans’ heavy midterm election losses.

Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis is being floated as a possible replacement.
